# Elaine Adamson Consulting

> Fractional HR consultant for scaling startups (Series A and up, under 500 employees). Elaine Adamson diagnoses what is broken in a company's people function before fixing it, then embeds to do the work.

## Services
- HR strategy and build: function build or rebuild, org design and leveling, handbooks, manager playbooks
- Systems and data: HRIS selection, implementation, migration, data cleanup, reporting
- Payroll and benefits: US multi-state payroll, benefits and 401(k), leave, wage-and-hour, I-9 compliance
- Employee lifecycle: onboarding, manager enablement, employee relations, exits
- Global and scale: international expansion, EOR and PEO off-ramps, entity setup, multi-country payroll

## How engagements work
- Map: a scoped diagnostic with a set end date. Most engagements start here.
- Build: embedded at least 15 hours a week, doing the work
- Sustain: monthly check-ins and on-call access after a Build
- Interim HR: time-boxed coverage while a permanent HR leader is hired

## EOR off-ramps
- 190+ employees moved off EORs across 5 countries: UK, Japan, Colombia, Poland, and Mexico. Teams from 2 to 100 people.
